meta.purpose: Fresh, source-linked player availability context. Official statuses can hold public signals; they never alter Model A automatically.
meta.notes_policy: Official ACC, Big Ten, Big 12, SEC and Pac-12 reports are ingested when published. A failed source retains its last still-valid official snapshot. Empty status remains unknown, not healthy.
meta.adjustment_policy: No automated source is assigned a point value. Current official or ESPN QB Out, Doubtful, Questionable, or Game Time Decision statuses withhold the public signal pending resolution.
